trust_decision.summary: Whether the current user holds the entity's `create` authorization before Sharp renders or executes a quick-creation form is decided per request in ApiEntityListQuickCreationCommandController (create/store) through SharpAuthorizationManager::check('create', $entityKey), which resolves the entity's $prohibitedActions and policy.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the 'quick creation command endpoints'; grep for QuickCreation lands on this class, whose two public methods are exactly the two endpoints registered at src/routes/api.php:34-38.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: formEntityKey is only the key used to pick which form to build; the entity the list belongs to (entityKey) is the one the authorization check guards, and the advisory example (and the fix's own test) use the same key for both.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: List entity/instance commands (export, duplicate, etc.) are authorized only by their own Command::authorize(), which defaults to true, and their controllers share the same HandlesCommandForm/HandlesCommandResult traits; hoisting an entity-level `create` check into HandlesEntityCommand or Command::authorize() would 403 every command for users lacking create rights.

O6_input_shapes: GET form-fetch vs POST submit: both handled (src/routes/api.php:34-38, fix.diff:23 and fix.diff:31)

multiform key, e.g. 'person:colleague' - collapsed to the base key by SharpEntityManager::entityFor (src/Utils/Entities/SharpEntityManager.php:13), so the fix cannot distinguish a sub-form from its base entity
distinct formEntityKey (the form actually submitted), left unchecked by the fix (src/Http/Controllers/Api/Commands/ApiEntityListQuickCreationCommandController.php:33 and :62)
posted `data` array, validated by the form (src/Http/Controllers/Api/Commands/ApiEntityListQuickCreationCommandController.php:69)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Quick creation with formEntityKey pointing at a different, entity-map-mapped entity: the instance actually created is entityFor($formEntityKey)'s entity (line 62 builds its form, QuickCreationCommand::execute calls $sharpForm->update(null,...)), but only entityKey's `create` ability is checked.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: formEntityKey is treated as a presentation detail (which form to render) rather than the protected item; the advisory's example and test use entityKey === formEntityKey, and the upstream check reads entityKey.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and same two methods (0 files, 0 packages); the design intent that the mapped entity's create right matters is signalled one file away at src/Http/Controllers/EntityListController.php:114

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second quick-creation controller for another surface (embedded entity list / show page) that builds the form from $formEntityKey and calls update(null, $data) without the check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sharp already ships one controller per command surface (ApiEntityListEntityCommandController, ApiEntityListInstanceCommandController, ApiShowInstanceCommandController) and quick creation is already driven from embedded entity lists (resources/js/entity-list/components/EntityList.vue:188-200), so a maintainer copying the pattern omits the check again.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A QuickCreationCommand variant carrying its own authorize()/authorizeFor() and relying on it instead of a controller-level entity check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other command in Sharp is authorized by Command::authorize() (src/EntityList/Commands/Command.php:161) and HandlesEntityCommand/HandlesInstanceCommand enforce exactly that, so a maintainer naturally models quick creation the same way.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization (broken access control on a creation endpoint)

O10_build.toolchain: composer; PHP 8.3-8.5; Pest 3/4 + PHPUnit 11/12 on orchestra/testbench (composer.json:74, phpunit.xml)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Http/Api/Commands/ApiEntityListQuickCreationCommandControllerTest.php - Pest HTTP tests for both quick-creation endpoints (form fetch, store, custom field subsets, EEL link action); run with `vendor/bin/pest`

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `$this->authorizationManager->check('create', $entityKey)` as the first line of both create() and store() and stop, or move it into the shared HandlesEntityCommand/HandlesCommandForm traits so every list command inherits it.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Http/Controllers/Api/Embeds/ApiEmbedsFormController.php:17 gates an embedded create-form with check('entity') while its own update sibling at :36 uses check('create') - a different feature (embedded forms), not the quick-creation sink.

Command controllers (e.g. src/Http/Controllers/Api/Commands/ApiEntityListEntityCommandController.php:36) never consult the entity authorization manager at all; commands rely on Command::authorize() (src/EntityList/Commands/Command.php:161). Separate advisory family, not pursued.
